about: Generated by python -m dclab_rnd.data_catalog from the contracts and the code; never edited by hand.

agent_text.meaning: what an agent said; leaves redacted

cell_values.meaning: a value of a table; never recorded

count.meaning: numbers; leaves at improve and train

meta.meaning: ids, codes, names of things; leaves at improve and train

model_text.meaning: a prompt or a reply; leaves only at train, redacted, and only if the workspace kept it and the purpose was allowed to keep it

person_text.meaning: what a person typed; leaves redacted

consent.improve: may be read and turned into evaluation cases
consent.operate: kept to run the product; never leaves
consent.rule: a record leaves only if it was written at that level (its stamp) and the switch is on now

dataset_builders.what: One set per decision point: the state in bands, every answer, the label by source and the outcome (23.5).
Home conversations that ended in a build, as chat examples; an edited reply is the reply (23.6).
A person's correction of a decision, as a preferred and a rejected answer.
An agent's moves in a run: the tool, its verdict, the step; no cell value or free text.
Solution workflows drawn from problem and data, with the validator's verdict.
Flagged sessions as candidate benchmark cases for a reviewer.

dataset_builders.needs: nothing (the owner's own records of how DCLab is built)
dataset_builders.what: How DCLab itself was built: one record per package, kept for the owner's SFT.
Each decision with the number that followed it, judged against its reference (23.5).
One row per turn of a conversation: the message, the steps, the model calls, the moves, the decisions, the feedback and the outcomes, joined by ids (23.10); no free text under improve.
Each model call whose prompt and reply were kept (train only; never a call that was shown cell values), with the check's verdict and the feedback (23.10).
A person's words as a problem map of parts: the map first drawn, the one built from, the person's edits as the correction, and what the programme did against its best leaf (24.7).
A sub-problem routed to an approach: its state, the candidates with the codes that refuted them, the one chosen and what became of it; codes and counts only (24.7).

What the system and Claude, as the AI-first expert, answered on the same inputs: every twin step, the preference pairs a truth decided, the expert's records with what became of them, and Claude's answers as a teacher's beside the rule's at the ledger's points, one set per use (workflow, technical); Claude's words redacted (25.7).

decision_points.about: Which tool does the agent call next?
decision_points.decided_in: agents/runtime.py: each tool a model chose among those it was offered

decision_points.about: Is the numeric column a code for categories?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/engine.py prepare: a numeric column read as codes

decision_points.about: Does the column name the entity rows must be grouped by?
decision_points.decided_in: the same save: the proposed entity column against the saved one

decision_points.about: Is the column an identifier (never a feature)?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/solution.py and draft/api.py: a saved solution, the proposal's identifiers against the person's

decision_points.about: What is done with the column's missing values?
Which role does the column play?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/engine.py prepare: each column's role

decision_points.about: Is the column the time each row happened?
decision_points.decided_in: the same save: the proposed time column against the saved one

decision_points.about: Which quick action does the person's message ask for?
Is this table a list of known cases rather than the rows to score?
decision_points.decided_in: draft/pipeline.py: a table read as a list of known cases

decision_points.about: Which cleaning step applies?
decision_points.decided_in: draft/clean.py: each cleaning step applied

decision_points.about: Which rows does a run read?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/engine.py prepare: which rows the runs read

decision_points.about: Is the experiment's result kept?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/engine.py stage_models: each review round's experiment kept or dropped

decision_points.about: Which experiment is run next?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/engine.py stage_models: each review round's experiment, the rules' first and the critic's

decision_points.about: Would the column be unknown at the prediction moment, or encode the target?
decision_points.decided_in: the same save: the audit's flags against the columns the person forbade

decision_points.about: Which feature recipe is kept?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/engine.py stage_features: the recipe the rule kept

decision_points.about: May the holdout be used again?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/graph.py: a final stage run again, with or without a person's reason

decision_points.about: Does a mirror flip keep the image's label (may training images be flipped)?
decision_points.decided_in: kinds/embedded.py leakage: whether mirrored training images keep their label, measured on held-apart sources

decision_points.about: Is the image's label likely wrong?
decision_points.decided_in: kinds/embedded.py leakage: training images whose near copies, else nearest images, mostly carry the other label

decision_points.about: Are two images of different sources the same subject photographed again?
decision_points.decided_in: kinds/embedded.py leakage (an image table): pairs of training images of different sources, by their pictures' cosine

decision_points.about: What is improved next?
Which key joins the label file to the table?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/labels.py review: the key that joins the label file

decision_points.about: How are the outcomes known?
Is the lesson kept for the workspace?
decision_points.decided_in: lessons.py review: a reviewer's verdict on a lesson

decision_points.about: What did the person change in the problem map?
decision_points.decided_in: draft/map.py edit: a person's add, remove, merge or confirm of the map

decision_points.about: Is the problem one problem, or several that depend on each other?
decision_points.decided_in: draft/map.py draw: the rules' reading of the words and the decomposer's, when it serves

decision_points.about: Which metric decides, with its constraints?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/engine.py prepare: the person's metric or the kind's default

decision_points.about: Which model family is kept?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/engine.py stage_models: the family the rule kept

decision_points.about: Is the model promoted to the project's champion?
Does the critic's review change the model?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/engine.py stage_models: the critic's rounds kept or dropped

decision_points.about: What does the monitoring say is wrong?
Is the new model released?
Is the model retrained now?
Is the release rolled back?
Which family of problem is it?
decision_points.decided_in: draft/api.py build: the card's family

decision_points.about: Which domain pack does it start from?
decision_points.decided_in: draft/chat.py: the pack detected or chosen

decision_points.about: Is the problem understood enough to build?
decision_points.decided_in: draft/api.py build: whether the card is ready

decision_points.about: How complete is the proposal for a reviewer?
Is the report's line kept?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/solution_report.py: the report's lines kept and dropped

decision_points.about: How are the leaves of the programme combined: one alone, a fusion, a gate?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/programme.py run: the composition chosen on validation among every leaf alone and the fusions (ledger/capture.composition_chosen), with a measured label once the holdout is read

decision_points.about: Which approach solves this sub-problem?
decision_points.decided_in: draft/map.py store_routes: the approach the router chose for each sub-problem, the rules' and the advisor's

decision_points.about: How many folds?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/engine.py prepare: the folds from the settings

decision_points.about: How are rows split for validation and the holdout?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/engine.py prepare: the kind's split for the solution

decision_points.about: Which column is the outcome?
decision_points.decided_in: the same save: the proposed outcome against the saved one

decision_points.about: Which task is it?
decision_points.decided_in: the same save: the detected task against the saved one

decision_points.about: At which threshold or budget are cases flagged?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/engine.py stage_final: the operating point from the budget or costs

decision_points.about: Is the tuned configuration kept over the default?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/engine.py stage_final: whether the tuned configuration beat the default by its margin

decision_points.about: Is this move allowed now?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/graph.py check: every move, allowed or refused

decision_points.about: Which question is asked next, if any?
decision_points.decided_in: draft/chat.py next_question: the question asked next, or none

decision_points.about: Which earlier step is revisited, if any?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/graph.py: a completed stage run again

decision_points.about: Is the stage's choice approved?
decision_points.decided_in: studio/engine.py approve: the rule's choice and the person's

decision_points.about: Is the work finished, or does it go on?
decision_points.decided_in: agents/runtime.py: why an agent's run ended

decision_points.about: Which solution workflow does it follow?
decision_points.decided_in: draft/workflow.py: the solution workflow drawn

retention.what: a deleted project, draft or session

tables.what: A project's log of what happened, one line per move.
one row per step of an agent run (dclab_rnd/agents/traces.py, package A2.3); never a cell value
a personal API token for /mcp clients and scripts (10.2): acts as its user in one workspace; only its hash is kept
A person who can sign in (accounts on); the password hash is the only secret kept.
every governed action, append-only: a trigger refuses update and delete (dclab_rnd/audit.py, 10.4)
what was right, from one source; a new label supersedes, never edits (19.7, 19.8)
how a decision turned out, append-only (dclab_rnd/ledger/outcomes.py, 23.5)
every decision DCLab makes, append-only (dclab_rnd/ledger, 19.7)
A draft before it is a project: the problem, the data analysis and the understanding.
A draft's chat, pipeline and analysis events, in order.
every event of every session, append-only: a trigger refuses update and delete (dclab_rnd/experience, 19.2)
An intern session: its goal, steps, budget and final report.
a piece of background work: a stage run, a data pipeline, synthetic data, an intern turn (dclab_rnd/jobs, 10.3)
A person's role in a workspace.
whether a model's output passed the code that checks it (package A1.3)
requests to an endpoint and model stop until a time, after a refusal that stays (models/pause.py, 10.5)
the model gateway's usage log (dclab_rnd/models/usage.py); one row per request
which tier serves or shadows each purpose, with its history (dclab_rnd/models/routing.py, A6.4); one row per workspace
how a shadow model's answer compared with the served one (dclab_rnd/models/shadow.py, A6.4); never content
A project: its solution, settings and stage state, as one document.
A stage's result record (evidence, claims, notes, its run).
a table or artifact kept in file storage: where, how big, its hash (dclab_rnd/storage/files.py, 9.3); never a credential
Every move the workflow validator checked, allowed or not.
requests and bytes counted per user and per workspace in a window (dclab_rnd/limits.py, 10.6)
a signed-in browser (dclab_rnd/accounts, 10.2): the cookie's token is never stored, only its SHA-256
A workspace: the unit that owns every other row.
a lesson from a finished project, proposed, then accepted or rejected by a reviewer (dclab_rnd/lessons.py, A5.3)
